Fixed. `split column` now supports `-n`/`--number`, mirroring `split row`.

Changes in `crates/nu-command/src/strings/split/column.rs`:
- Added the `-n`/`--number` flag to the signature (`named` with `SyntaxShape::Int`)
- `Arguments` now carries `max_split: Option<usize>`; both `run` and `run_const` read the flag
- Splitting uses `regex.splitn(&s, max_split)` when a number is given, so the nth column contains the remainder of the string (closes nu#13773)
- Added an example: `'a--b--c' | split column -n 2 '--'` → `a` / `b--c`
